(tsa)༄༅/ /sman bla'i mdo chog gi dri ba me tog mda' 'joms dang*/byang pa bdag po la dri ba'i skor bzhugs/ /na mo bā+ai ḍūr+ya pra bha s+ye/sa skyong rga

tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// sman bla'i mdo chog gi dri ba me tog mda' 'joms dang*/ byang pa bdag po la dri ba'i skor bzhugs// na mo bā+ai ḍūr+ya pra bha s+ye/ sa skyong rgyal pos mchod pa'i gnas thob nas// pha rol dpung dang nad chen gzhom slad du// de bzhin gshegs bdun mchod par mdzad rnams la// dogs pa'i gnas 'ga' dri'o dge bar gson// de yang 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi khyad par rgyas pa'i cho ga mdo sde las btus pa zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa 'di las brtsams ste/ dogs pa'i gnas 'ga' zhig dri ba ni/ gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad tshang bar bzhugs pa nas/ sgo bzhi la rgyal po chen po bzhi bzhugs pa'i bar gzhal yas khang sgo rkyang gcig bshad pa 'di'i lung mdo sde gang na yod/ mdo sde brgyad brgya pa zhes bya ba de na ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa bdun na gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa mi 'dra ba bdun bshad cing*/ 'khor de rnams kyi nges pa ma bshad/ yang gzhal yas khang gi skyed tshul rgyud sde nas 'byung ba dang mi 'dra bar smon lam gyi sgo nas bskyed pa ni ci/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad ka dkyil 'khor de'i gtso bo yin nam/ gang yang rung ba gcig yin/ yang na/ sman pa'i rgyal po dkyil 'khor de'i gtso bo yin no zhes 'chad pa ltar na/ de'i cho ga bdun gyi tha mar mdzad pa ci/ yang brgyad ka dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin par 'chad pa ltar na/ dkyil 'khor gcig gi dbus su gtso bo brgyad cig char du 'byung ba de lta bu'i sngags lugs kyi mthun dpe gang na yod/ yang sher phyin gtso bo byed pa ltar na/ de de'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo byed pa'i khungs gang na yod/ ji skad du/ chos po ti yang bzhugs/ zhes pa khungs yin na ni/ chos dkon mchog dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog 'khor du 'byung ba de lta bu'i bshad pa dang mthun dpe gzhan gang na yod/

de dus kyi chos po ti de yum sher phyin gyi glegs bam yin nam/ mdo sde 'di nyin yin/ dang po ltar na de'i shes byed kyi khungs gang na yod/ gnyis pa ltar na/ yum chen mo dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor 'jog pa dang ji ltar 'brel/ de ltar mod kyi glegs bam de'i bzhugs sa ni gang gi thad na byed/ sman bla'i pho brang du grags pa de'i bzhugs tshul ltar byed na/ de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad zhal phyir bstan pas phyin ci log tu ji ltar mi 'gyur/ bri bya la de ltar byung kyang sgom don la de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad kyi zhal nang du chos dkon mchog la ston rgyu yin na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo chos dkon mchog gi bsgrub mchod 'khor brgyad kyi tha mar 'chad pa ci/ bstan bcos mkhan pos dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo chos dkon mchog gi spyan 'dren ma bshad par 'khor rnams la spyan 'dren bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' zhes sogs su/ chos dkon mchog gi sgrub mchod bstan par 'dod na/ de'i skabs kyi chos de lung rtogs chos dbyings gsum po gang la byed/ 'dir mdo las/ mdo sde de nyid zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur klog cing mchod pa 'bul bar bshad pa yin pa la/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' zhes sogs tshig rkang ston nas phyag mchod kyi tshig brjod pas/ chos dkon mchog bsgrub mchod du ji ltar 'gyur/ bar gyi snam bu la zhes pa'i snam bu de gang la byed/ sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa'i tshig 'di mdo sde las 'byung ba yin nam/ bstan bcos mkhan pos mdzad pa yin/ byin gyis brlob pa'i tshe sa gzhi 'di nyid de dang de'i ngo bor byin gyis brlob pa yin nam/ zhing gzhan zhig 'dir 'byung bar smon lam 'debs pa yin/ gnyis pa ltar na/ skabs 'dir sa'i lha mo'i sta gon la sogs pa mi dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ de mi dgos na/ sa gzhi byin rlabs kyi tshig 'di dag gis gsang sngags lugs kyi dkyil 'khor bstan par 'dod pa de dang ji ltar 'brel/

lugs dang por ltar na yang dkyil 'khor bzhengs zin pa'i 'og rol tu der byin gyis brlob pa yin nam/ der bslabs nas dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yin/ gnyis pa ltar na/ sa blang ba sogs ci'i phyir mi dgos/ yang*/ mdo lugs kho na yin pas mi 'gal ba 'dod na/ gsang sngags kyi cho ga la ma brten par sgrub pa po tha mal pas zhing khams gzhan gyi sangs rgyas zhing 'dir spyan 'dren ji ltar nus/ yang bum pa sta gon bshad pa 'di la dgos pa'i khyad par ci zhig yod/ dus kyi khyad par zhag bdun nas zhag nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar gyi nges par bshad pa dang*/ tshes brgyad nas zla ba phyi ma'i bco lnga bar gyi nges pa bshad pa de'i khyad par ci/ spyan 'dren gyi skabs su lha dam tshig pa bskyed pa la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa yin nam/ gdan rkyang pa bskyed pa la gzugs kyi sku spyan 'dren pa yin/ dang po ltar na/ bya rgyud du 'grel tshul ji ltar byed/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du de skyed zin nas 'og tu spyan 'dren gyi tshig 'byung ba ji ltar yin/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi mtshan brjod pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal lan bdun bdun kho na grangs nges pa 'di la mdo sde'i khungs gsal po ji ltar yong*/ bai ḍūr+ya'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di ni sman pa'i rgyal po kho na'i gzungs yin nam/ brgyad ka thun mong gi gzungs yin/ dang po ltar na/ cho ga 'di sngags lugs su byed pa de'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi dbang du byas pa'i gzungs sngags gang yin/ yang*/ oṃ bhai ṣa dz+ye/ zhes pa'i gzungs 'di sman pa'i rgyal po'i gzungs sngags yin pa'i mdo rgyud kyi khungs gsal po gang na yod/ skyabs grol gyi skabs su sku gzugs bdun bya zhes bshad pa de sman pa'i rgyal po kho na yin nam/ spyir de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku yin/ yang mkhan pos mdzad pa'i gzhung 'di na cho ga 'di'i yan lag tu shākya thub pa'i mtshan nas brjod pa dang*/

de'i sku gzugs bzhengs dgos par bshad pa 'di la/ mdo sde'i khungs gsal po gang na yod/ yang mdo sde de na cho ga 'di'i yan lag tu mdo sde 'di nyid la phyag 'tshal byed pa dang*/ mdo sde'i dbang po 'di zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur bklags dgos par bshad na/ de ltar byed pa cho ga 'di'i gzhung gi cha shas gang gis ston/ zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgur bklag par bya'o// zhes brjod pa tsam gyis klog par 'gyur ram/ klog mkhan zur pa gcig dgos pa yin/ yang chos dkon mchog la phyag mchod bya ba'i skabs kyi chos de lung rtogs gnyis las gang yin/ dang po ltar na/ lung tsam po'am/ mdo sde 'di kho na la byed/ yang 'jam dpal dang*/ skyabs 'gro la sogs pa mdo sde'i zhu lan byed pa po gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang phyag mchod kyi yul du bshad nas/ kun dga' bo mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci/ zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu la rnam par shes pa slar log ces pa shi zin pa'i rnam par shes pa slar log pa yin nam/ tshe ring du song ba gang yin/ skyabs grol gyi ngos 'dzin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la byed pa dag yod na/ de'i shes byed ci/ mdo rgyud kyi glegs bam gzhan na skyabs grol gyi ming can bshad pa yod dam med/ de skad 'di ni paṇa chen gyi// cho ga'i gzhung gis dngos bstan dang*// mdo las 'byung ba sgrig pa'i tshul// ji bzhin shes pa'i phyir dris kyi// cho ga'i gzhung la skyon brjod dang*// gzhan dag khyad du gsod phyir min// de ltar shes na bklags tsam gyis// don grub cho ga yid 'ong 'di// mi shes gtam gyis ma bslad par// cho ga'i gzhung bzhin klog par mdzod// nam yang bsnan par mi bya ste// phri bas chog pa du ma snang*// sman rgyal kho na mchod pa'i tshul// skyabs grol zhabs kyis bshad pa bzhin// de skad 'di yang shākya yi// dge slong mchog ldan legs pa'i blos// g.yas ru mdzad kyi mthong smon nas// phyogs brgyar springs pa'i yi ge'o//

rgyud bzhi spyi dang so so'i ming tsam dang*/ de nas khungs su drangs pa'i lung gsal po cung zad kyang mi 'byung ba de ji ltar lags/ khungs thub kyi bstan bcos de dang der/ sman dpyad kyi byung tshul 'chad pa na/ tshangs pas skyes dgu'i bdag po sogs phyi rol pa'i drang srong rnams kho na la brgyud pa'i tshul bshad nas/ sangs rgyas kyi gsungs tshul mdo tsam mi 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan ci lags/ de'i dus kyi tshangs pa de rgyal ba nyid yin na/ rig byed kyi bstan bcos cha shas su gyur pa'i tshe'i rig byed mdzad pa po yang*/ rgyal ba nyid du zhal gyis bzhes dgos pas/ rang re'i ston pa 'dis chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor ba'i gong du rig byed bzhi yod par gsungs pa de ji ltar drang*/ yang bka' ni bklags pa tsam gyi go bar nus la/ bstan bcos la ni rgya 'grel med par go bar mi nus pas/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi go rim bzlog par mi 'gyur ba de ji ltar lags/ bstan bcos de nyid phyi rol pa'i yin par bzhed na/ phyi nang gi gso dpyad kyi khyad par de gang lags/ gang la med pa'i legs bshad kyi khyad par de la ji tsam zhig yod ces/ thog mar 'di tsam zhig zhus nas/ bka' stsal pa'i lan la brtags te zhib par rjes su zhu 'tshal lo// de nas zhu ba'i don gsum pa ni/ ji skad du/ khyim gcig la ni nyi ma gnas pas mtha' dag dus kyi tshogs dang khyim rnams byed// ces gsungs pa'i don la/ 'grel pa las rgyas par gsungs pa de rnams sgra ji bzhin pa min par 'dra lags te/ mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i don gsum tshan zhig yod par go lags so// ji ltar zhes bka' stsal na/ zla ba'i nya skar dang mi mthun pa dang*/ nyi ma'i 'char sa dang mi mthun pa dang*/ nyi ma khyim la gnas tshul dang mi mthun pa'o// dang po ni/ sa dum bu bcu gnyis su sa ga'i zla ba dang*/ snron gyi zla ba dang*/ chu stod kyi zla ba sogs bcu gnyis po dus cig char du 'byung na/

zhag gcig la nya skar bcu gnyis po lhan cig tu tshogs dgos par 'gyur ro// gal te 'gyur gyis nongs par zhal gyis bzhes na/ lo tsā ba blo gros rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i bi brta'i nang na/ skar ma bcu gnyis kyi skad dod kho na snang gi dpyid zla 'bring po la sogs pa'i skad dod mi bzhugs pas ji ltar lags/ gnyis pa ni/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi lho bgrod mthar thug gi nyi ma 'char sa dang*/ gling de'i byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i nyi ma 'char sa gcig par 'gyur te/ shar gling dbus ma'i ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi/ nyi ma phyed pa'i sa tshod gcig pa'i phyir/ yang de'i dus kyi nyi ma nub sa gnyis gcig par 'gyur te/ nub gling dbus ma'i ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi ma phyed pa'i sa tshod gcig yin pa'i phyir/ yang lho gling dbus ma'i dus de gnyis kyi nyi ma phyed dus kyi nam mkha'i sa tshod gcig par 'gyur te/ shar gling dbus ma'i nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi/ nyi ma nub sa gcig pa dang*/ nub gling dbus ma'i dus de gnyis kyi nyi ma 'char sa gcig pa'i phyir/ thal ba de gsum gyi rtags dang khyab pa khas blangs/ chos can gyi steng du thal chos la mngon sum gyi tshad ma'i bsal ba zhugs so// gsum pa ni/ lho gling dbus mar dgun nyi zlog pa'i nyin mtshan de la/ byang gling dbus mar dbyar nyi zlog pa yin na/ byang gling dbus ma de chos can/ skar ma chu stod kyi steng du gnas shing*/ gzhu'i khyim du dbyar nyi zlog par thal/ gnas dang dus de lho gling dbus ma'i dgun nyi zlog pa gang zhig de dang khyod du dbyar nyi zlog pa dus mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po mngon sum/ gnyis pa khas blangs/ khyab pa tshad mas grub/ thal ba la mngon sum gyi bsal ba zhugs so// ji ltar byang gling dbus ma'i dbyar gyi nyi ma de lho bgrod mthar thug nas zlog par thal/ skar ma chu stod kyi steng du zlog pa gang zhig

de byang gling dbus ma'i lho skar mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ rtags snga ma khas blangs/ khyab pa tshad mas grub/ thal chos mngon sum gyis bsal/ rtags gnyis pa ma grub na/ de chos can/ de'i lho skar mthar thug yin te/ nyi ma la ltos pa'i lho bgrod mthar thug gi sa nas shar te/ sa der nub pa'i phyir/ der nub pa yin te/ lho gling dbus ma'i lho bgrod mthar thug nas shar ba'i phyir/ yang byang gling dbus ma der chos can/ skar ma lag gi steng du nyi ma gnas shing*/ 'khrig pa'i khyim du dgun nyi zlog par thal/ gnas dus der/ lho gling dbus mar dbyar nyi zlog pa gang zhig de dang khyod du/ dgun nyi zlog pa'i dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ rtags snga ma mngon sum/ gnyis pa khas blangs/ thal ba la mngon sum dang khas blangs kyi bsal ba zhugs so// mngon sum gyi bsal ba zhugs tshul ni snga ma dang 'dra la/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhu'i rnam pa'i dus khyim dag la zhes sogs kyis nag pa nas nam gru'i bar gyi skar ma phyed dang bcu bzhi lho phyogs su gzhu'i rnam par gnas shing*/ chu las bdun khri lnga stong 'phags pa dang*/ tha skar nas nag pa'i phyed kyi bar gyi skar ma phyed dang bcu bzhi po de/ byang phyogs su pad 'dab bzang po bzhin du gnas pa dang*/ sa'i steng nas dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong 'phags par gsungs so// zhes rnam par dpyad pa'i zhus len bka' stsal du gsol/ 'dir zhus ci gsungs brtag pa'i phyir min te// khyad du gsod pa'i phyir du yin re skan// rtsod tsam lhur len dag gis ci zhig bya// gangs can 'di na chen por rlom rnams kyang*// dpyod ldan mang du gsan pa 'ga' mi snang*// khungs med rtog ge'i tshig sbyor gyis khengs te// rig gnas bdud rtsi shong ba'i snod ma gyur// mang du gsan khyod dri ba'i yul du khums// chos kyi 'bel gtam yid 'ong pad+mo'i phreng*// snyan grags nor bu'i mdangs dang lhan cig tu// don gnyer rnam dpyod gsal ba'i me long la// nam yang rtag tu gsal bar 'char gyur cig

/ces yul dbus kyi thos pa 'dzin pa'i dge slong dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis/ mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i thig le nas byang ngam rings yid bzhin gyi mtsho chen po'i 'gram/ ma la ya'i skyed mos tshal gyi ngogs/ dpal kā la pa'i pho brang mthon po'i dbus su/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgya mtsho rnam rgyal grags pa bzang po'i drung du gus par phul ba'i zhu yig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
